title: Add song
subtitle: Paste the link of the recording the band wants to play. BandSync identifies that version and prepares the song.
existingSubtitle: Reference recording of “{{title}}”. What the band already filled in is not changed.

search.heading: Find the recording
search.title: Song title
search.source: Results from MusicBrainz, an open, community-maintained database.
search.emptyHint: Check the spelling, remove the artist, or continue without an identifier.
search.versionsHint: Each row is a different recording. Live, studio and other performers' versions do not share tempo or arrangement.

recording.heading: Reference recording
recording.composerUnknown: The source does not say who wrote this recording. The field stays empty for the band to fill in.

prepare.heading: Prepare song
prepare.explain: Preparing stores this recording as the band's reference and opens a workspace for each instrument. Tempo, key and structure are analysed only from authorised audio; a link is not that.

skip.no_recording_identifier: No recording identifier: nothing was looked up at the source.
skip.no_authorized_audio: No authorised audio file was provided. Use “Listen with the microphone” to estimate tempo and key.
skip.engine_not_configured: The audio analysis engine is not configured in this environment yet.

job.failedBody: Preparation did not finish. You can try again.

error.upstream_unavailable: The music data service did not respond.

results.heading: What was found
results.notAnalysed: Tempo, key, time signature, harmony and structure were not analysed. That needs an audio file the band may process and an analysis engine, which is not configured yet. No value is made up.

review.heading: Band review
review.hint: The values below belong to the band's version and feed the live rehearsal metronome. Confirm them by ear; nothing is filled in by estimate.
review.beforeReferenceChange: confirmed before the reference changed; check again

repertoire.heading: Add to a repertoire
repertoire.none: The band has no repertoires yet.

link.heading: Paste the recording's link
link.label: Recording link
link.accepted: Accepts YouTube, YouTube Music and Spotify links.

problem.invalid_url: This does not look like a valid link. Copy the full address, starting with https://.
problem.unsupported_platform: Unsupported platform. Use a YouTube, YouTube Music or Spotify link.
problem.unsupported_link: This link does not point to one recording (it is a playlist, album, channel or short link). Open the track or video and copy its link.
problem.reference_not_found: Reference not found: the platform does not recognise this link. Check that the video or track still exists.

link.titleHint: Check it: a video's name is not always the song's name.
link.artistHint: The video's channel is not always the artist. Fill it in if you know.
link.artistHintSpotify: Spotify does not name the artist through this endpoint. Fill it in if you know.
link.sameHint: Only stores the link. Analyses and confirmed values stay valid.
link.otherHint: Replaces the band's reference. The previous one stays in the history.
link.usedBy_one: Careful: this link is already the reference recording of {{titles}} in this band. Check that it really is this song's recording.
link.usedBy_other: Careful: this link is already the reference recording of {{titles}} in this band. Check that it really is this song's recording.

reference.heading: Reference recording
reference.fixHint: The title and artist below are what the band sees. What the platform said is kept.
reference.linkPendingBody: The band knows which recording it means but has not given its link yet. No other recording is chosen automatically.
reference.playerUnavailable: Player unavailable: the platform does not allow this recording to play here. Use “Open original recording”.
reference.shared: Every member sees this same reference. Each one listens through the platform itself: BandSync does not download or relay the audio.

audio.noneHint: A link does not allow downloading or processing the audio. Upload a file the band may use, or use the microphone.

analysis.pendingHint: There is an authorised file not analysed yet.
analysis.noneHint: Play the reference and let BandSync listen through the microphone, or upload an authorised file. BPM, key and meter are only estimated from audio.
analysis.doneHint: BandSync's estimates, review needed. Confirm the band's values above.

arrangement.reviewHint: Check BPM, key and meter, then finish the review.

audio.explain: Upload a file the band has the right to process (own recording, licensed or permitted). It is tied to the reference recording. Audio from YouTube or Spotify is not downloaded.
audio.rightsLabel: Basis of the right to use it
audio.declaration: I declare the band has the right to process this file.

replace.title: Replace the reference recording?
replace.body: This song already has a reference recording. Do you want to replace it? The existing musical data will be kept, but may need to be reviewed.
replace.workDone: Already done with the current reference:
replace.keepHint: “Keep current reference” prepares the song with the recording already set; the new link is not used. Nothing is deleted with either option.

listen.title: Listen to the reference recording
listen.intro: Play the reference recording and let BandSync listen through this device's microphone for up to a minute. It estimates tempo, beats, meter and key.
listen.tip1: Normal volume, close to the device, in a quiet room.
listen.tip2: It can play on another device, a speaker or the player below.
listen.tip3: Start where the whole band is playing (not the intro).
listen.privacy: The audio is analysed on this device only and then discarded. Nothing is recorded or sent: only the results.
listen.quiet: Almost nothing reaches the microphone. Turn the volume up or move the device closer.
listen.saved: Analysis saved. The values are estimates for the band to review.
listen.wasQuiet: The sound came in very low: check the values carefully.
listen.reviewHint: Check by ear and confirm under “Band arrangement”.

error.mic_denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow the microphone for this site in the browser settings and try again.
error.mic_unavailable: This device's microphone could not be used.
error.too_short: Too little audio. Listen for at least 15 seconds.
error.no_signal: Almost no sound was picked up. Turn the volume up or move the device closer.
error.decode_failed: This audio file could not be read.
error.failed: The analysis could not finish. Try again.

listen.nextTitle: Now let BandSync hear the recording
listen.nextBody: Play the reference recording near this device for about 30 seconds. BandSync estimates BPM, key and meter for the band to review. The link alone does not allow analysing the audio.

pre.pageSubtitle: The reference recording, the recording's pre-arrangement and the arrangement the band plays.
pre.heading: Recording pre-arrangement
pre.headingHint: A first map of the whole recording: estimated sections, bars and chords. It is kept as generated; the band's changes go to the band arrangement below.
pre.nextNoAudio: The link lets the band play the recording, not analyse it. Continue to choose how BandSync will hear the whole recording: an authorised file, the microphone, or your own marks while listening.
pre.nextWithAudio: There is authorised audio for this recording. Continue to map the whole recording.
pre.nextReady: The recording's pre-arrangement is ready for review.
pre.playerFailed: The official player did not load on this device. Open the recording on YouTube to listen.
pre.unavailableBody: BandSync has not heard this recording yet. A YouTube or Spotify link identifies the song and plays it in the official player, but does not allow downloading or processing its audio. Choose below how to generate the pre-arrangement; meanwhile the band can carry on with what is already verified.
pre.verifiedNone: Nothing verified yet beyond identifying the recording.
pre.stillNeededBody: Sections, bars, chords, key and repetitions only appear once BandSync hears the whole recording (authorised file or microphone) or someone marks the sections while listening.
pre.fileExplain: The full analysis runs on this device, from a file the band may process (own, licensed or authorised recording). YouTube or Spotify audio is never downloaded.
pre.generated: Pre-arrangement generated. Review it and save the band's version.
pre.micExplain: Play the whole recording, start to finish, near this device (the player above starts from the beginning). The audio is analysed here and discarded; only the map is saved. Quality depends on volume and the room.
pre.micTooShort: Listen to at least {{seconds}} seconds of the recording.
pre.marksExplain: Listen in the official player and tap “New section here” whenever the song moves to another part. BandSync counts bars from the tempo. Nothing is analysed: sections get letters (A, B, C…) for you to name.
pre.marksNeedPlayer: Marking while listening uses the official YouTube player, which is not available for this reference.
pre.marksTempoHint: Enter the band's BPM; bars cannot be counted without it.

marksTempoFrom.deezer: BPM published by Deezer for this recording (an estimate). Check it.

pre.marksNeedTempo: Enter a tempo and play the recording in the player to mark the sections.
pre.tempoFromDeezer: Bars counted from the BPM Deezer publishes, not from an analysis.
pre.noChordsMarks: No chords: marks do not analyse the audio.
pre.honesty: BandSync estimates from what it heard. Names such as “Chorus” only appear when a passage repeats; otherwise sections get letters. Check by ear before rehearsing.

editor.heading: Band arrangement
editor.headingHint: What the band plays, in order. Editing here never changes the recording's pre-arrangement.
editor.restartConfirm: The arrangement being edited will be replaced with the sections of the recording's pre-arrangement. The saved version only changes when you save.
editor.empty: No sections yet. Add sections or generate the recording's pre-arrangement.
editor.emptyWithPre: Start from the recording's pre-arrangement and adjust what the band will play.
editor.saveHint: Available on the song page and in Live rehearsal. Every saved version is kept in the history.
editor.bandValues: Band values: tempo, key and time signature

views.heading: Arrangement by instrument
views.label: Instrument
views.bassNotice: Harmonic map of the section — not the original bass line. Use an authorised tab for the line.
views.noChords: The band has not set chords for these sections yet.

noMaterial.drums: No drum map among the materials. Structure, bars and marks above come from the band arrangement.
noMaterial.bass: No authorised bass tab among the materials.
noMaterial.guitar: No guitar tab or chord chart among the materials.
noMaterial.keys: No keys chart or sheet music among the materials.
noMaterial.vocals: No lyrics among the materials. BandSync only shows lyrics the band added with the right to use them.
